value_assessment.benefit: Prevent repeated paid work, missed Issue revisions, unsupported improvement claims and cross-project dashboard omissions while keeping three main UI destinations.
value_assessment.cost: An additive state migration, a shared candidate pipeline and stricter evidence requirements; old insufficient experiment budgets now explicitly block promotion.
evidence: Task retries previously repeated all model stages.
Global task limits could hide a project's older records.
Strategy experiments needed the same task pipeline and independent-family evidence as real executions.

assessments.reason: Reviewed stage invalidation, patch replay, Issue continuation/revision handling, budget waiting, filter parity and preservation versus improvement contracts.

Candidate patches still pass frozen checks and read-only review. Protected overlays stay outside model workspaces. Authentication, per-project authorization and credentials remain separate from readiness detection.
Real tasks and experiments use one candidate function; readiness, discovery, recovery, context and dashboard queries have separate modules without new runtime dependencies.

Experiments cannot deliver. Validation precedes holdout exposure; family-level repeated wins and cost gates control promotion. Monitoring uses recorded strategy IDs and refuses ambiguous rollback attribution.
Backend behavior, frontend requests, real Chromium interactions, startup recovery and packaging are exercised. Synthetic model fixtures verify the controller, not real model capability gains.
Changes implement the seven approved areas with bilingual docs. No new remote repository, paid inference or public release is part of verification.

resolved_findings: Task pagination metadata must invalidate rendering even when the first page's rows do not change.
Postmerge verification and explicit reverts must use preservation rather than require another improvement.
A revision held by an active Issue run must survive later synchronization watermarks.
Budget waiting must appear in both frontend and server attention filters.
A rejected checked patch must not remain eligible for unchanged recovery replay.
Multiple participating strategies do not provide sufficient attribution to roll all of them back.
remaining_limits: This is author self-review, not an independent external review.
Provider protocol fixtures do not establish compatibility with every live provider account.
Independent task families and trustworthy acceptance checks remain prerequisites for meaningful strategy evidence.
The default evolution budget is intentionally below the stricter experiment minimum; users must supply cases and explicitly adjust limits.
